_readme: Add one block per project. Delete this line. Everything except name is optional.

_fields.name: short project name — shown on the card and the map
_fields.building: the establishment, e.g. 'Shangri-La The Fort'. This is the hero on a no-photo entry.
_fields.loc: City, Province — leave out and it won't pin on the map
_fields.lat/lng: decimal degrees. Omit and the project still lists, just isn't pinned.
_fields.sector: Healthcare | Hospitality | Retail · Automotive | Resort | Residential | Commercial | General Contractor
_fields.client: company name. For RESIDENTIAL always use 'Private client' — never a person's name.
